messages:
emma: heads up — after today's RBAC prune rollout we're seeing mass SCIM deprovisions from Okta, customers reporting lost roles. Not sure if KMS rekey earlier is related. Seen at ~09:12 UTC.


david: @emma can you paste the SCIM error logs? any 403/401s or decrypt errors?


emma: logs show 403 when provisioner talks to internal-provisioner, cc'ing snippet:
```
2026-03-23T09:12:34Z ERROR scim-provisioner request failed status=403 body=\"forbidden\" x-correlation=abc123
2026-03-23T09:12:36Z WARN kms decrypt failed key=proj-extid err=\"invalid key version\"
```


maria: OK — we rotated KMS alias at 08:50 and rolled the key version through the platform. We had a short window where old key was disabled. Did we pin the provisioner to the alias or to a key id?


david: provisioner uses alias lookup but caches key material for 5m. If alias swap happened, cached keys may still be used but decrypt should still work. 'invalid key version' rings like envelope mismatch.


jon: I can repro locally by hitting staging Okta SCIM with the same token. curl output:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer ...\" https://provisioner.internal/scim/Users/123
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"forbidden\"}
```
Auth looks fine. Maybe RBAC change removed the service account from 'provisioners' role.


emma: Good point. We pushed an RBAC prune to remove deprecated roles also at 08:55. I suspect the service-account lost the 'scim:write' permission.


maria: Checking audit logs now. Where are you seeing role change events?


emma: Console audit shows: user=deploy-bot action=prune_roles target=role:provisioner timestamp=2026-03-23T08:55:10Z
But the detailed entries for service-account membership removals are truncated.


david: That truncation is our other issue — audit-logs consumer crashed earlier (OOM) and rotated to cold storage. We're missing some per-principal actions.


jon: From Okta side we see SCIM requests coming in with a service account client-id 'svc-scim-01' but Okta says 'insufficient_scope'. Could be our JWT audience changed after token signing key rotate?


maria: We rotated our signing jwk at 08:47. If the client didn't refresh its token it would get 401, but Okta shows 403/insufficient_scope which usually maps to claims (scope/roles).


emma: Two correlated events within 10 minutes — jwk rotate (08:47), KMS alias rotate (08:50), RBAC prune (08:55) — likely combination caused service account to lose mapping.


david: Action plan: 1) Pause pruning rollout — rollback the RBAC prune. 2) Ensure provisioner service-account is re-added to provisioners role. 3) Re-run deprovision cleanup to re-create missing role assignments. 4) Surface full audit logs from cold storage for 08:40-09:20.


maria: I'm rolling back the prune now. Running:
```
./ops/role-pruner rollback --commit 2026-03-23T08:55
```
ETA 2m.


jon: I'm validating Okta tokens — hitting the token introspect and printing claims.
```
POST /oauth/introspect
client_id=svc-scim-01 -> scopes: [\"scim.write\",\"scim.read\"]
sub=svc-scim-01
roles=[\"service-connector\"]
```
Seems scim.write present.


emma: After rollback, I still see a small spike of deprovisions. We need to stop the provisioner queue to avoid more churn. @oncall-bot can you mute the scim-processor queue?


oncall-bot: scim-processor queue muted by emma. Reason: prevent deprovision churn. Duration: 30m.


david: Good. Maria — can you confirm KMS state? Are older key versions disabled or destroyed?


maria: older key material was scheduled for disable but we set state=disabled briefly then re-enabled the previous material. There is an audit entry showing disable window 08:50:05 — 08:52:10.


emma: That could have caused decrypt failures in the middle of requests. Combine that with role prune and rotated jwk — bad.


jon: For remediation, suggest: 1) rehydrate any users/groups removed accidentally (we have a snapshot from 08:45). 2) replay provisioning change events into a dry-run mode to assess gaps. 3) add a pre-check in prune job to ensure service-roles for system accounts remain.


david: Also add a post-rotate integration test: after any key/jwk rotate, run smoke against scim-provisioner and token introspect.


maria: I'm extracting the full logs from cold storage now and will attach link when ready. Also will open a PR to pin the provisioner to alias-increment fallback logic.


emma: I'll open an incident and notify affected customers. Brief summary: transient key disable + role prune + jwk rotate caused SCIM deprovision churn, rollback in progress. ETA for full restore 2-4h.


jon: I'll prepare a rollback script to reapply previous group mappings from snapshots.
```
python tools/replay_scim_changes.py --snapshot 2026-03-23T08:45 --dry-run
```


oncall-bot: incident created INC-20260323-42 by emma.
